style: 幽暗古木森林，沿用已认可的绘本密林构图

rules.title: 森林
rules.scatter_rule: 高树与灌木分层；树冠悬挑不算树根占地；根固定、顶部风摆。
rules.junction_rule: 岔路保留全部出口；树只在保护区外，中央出口不能被复制右路的树挡住。
rules.top_rule: 开放天空；只约束树冠覆盖，不能铺封闭屋顶。

ground.source: design_initial; measure runtime slope before acceptance

lighting.diagnostic: freeze exact camera and simulation; white ambient; fog/virtual lights disabled; bright background
lighting.acceptance: Diagnostic gaps are observations. Accept matched dark background/sky/fog joins when production lighting and supported light changes remain convincing; require local geometry for visibly lit gaps.

examples: old oak, split trunk, narrow trunk; root foot separate from canopy reach
left canopy, right canopy, overhead broken canopy
short grass, clover, leaf litter, fallen twigs
distant trunk mass and distant canopy mass
kit.root_policy: Tree trunk footprint only; canopy overhang may cross road. Grass roots follow terrain; rigid stumps use rigid support. Distant silhouettes never receive near-camera placement.
kit.assembly: Tree+root grass: one owner and seed. Root cover 1-3 clumps around trunk footprint, never pasted over entire trunk; inherit terrain, not canopy wind.
kit.light_fx: Preserve forest environment. Shared world-anchored curved mist, root-pinned foliage wind; no lamp per tree.
kit.junction: All exits share a clearing. Exclude trunk footprints from union of routes; overhead canopy may span exits without creating a closed ceiling.
kit.lighting_acceptance: Choose open/atmospheric/hybrid/geometric. Compare diagnostic with production lighting and actual permitted changes before deciding roof asset scope.
